selection_rule: Include a PNG only when the same stem has both .semantics.txt and .viewport.txt companions.
evidence_boundaries: Shared production Compose components rendered by desktop ImageComposeScene using synthetic host data.
Each capture retains its exact viewport and semantic/action notes. Dialog-body captures are identified in those notes.
These images do not prove Android device, emulator, Root/Binder, installer, real IME, lifecycle, real-account, or production-service execution.
Visual approximation to the supplied HTML is documented; pixel identity to browser fonts, shadows, or native dialog backdrops is not claimed.
The six excluded PNGs have no paired metadata and are stale outputs. They were not copied.
Capture bytes match the final full run; animated progress/ripple frames can differ across runs without changing viewport or semantic metadata.
